extract_js: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/jobs/"]')).map(a => ({ href: a.href.split('?')[0], title: a.innerText?.slice(0, 120) || '' })).filter(x => /\/jobs\/\d+-/.test(x.href)).reduce((acc, x) => { if (!acc.find(y => y.href === x.href)) acc.push(x); return acc; }, []).slice(0, 20)
rules: Do NOT navigate to bare wellfound.com/jobs (no filters)
Do NOT run site:wellfound.com WebSearch loops — use search_urls + company deep-dive
notes: WebFetch works when browser MCP unavailable
